# PREP change request

## Purpose and affected requirements
Describe exact R-number(s), branch and behavioral contract change.

## Privacy and provenance checklist
- [ ] No private-source/customer data/credentials leaked to PUBLIC
- [ ] Upstream source untouched; snapshot/rights/rollback reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Schema/exit status compatibility and exact version impact explained
- [ ] User-input paths, encoding, resource limits and review gates considered

## Verification (actual runs only)
- Exact commit SHA:
- OS/Node:
- Command:
- PASS / FAIL / SKIP:
- Package/consumer E2E:
- Unverified:
- Rollback:

## Release
- [ ] No unauthorized spend, network upload, visibility change or deployment
- [ ] STATUS.md and HANDOFF.md updated for material work
